summary: VO(5,10) shows no direction on its own. Crossing up through 0 did the same as random entries on 1h, 4h and daily. The settings that beat random fire in volatile candles, in a window where price rose overall. The result that holds up runs against longs: on 4h, entries as VO crossed down through 0 did 0.24% worse than random after 20 candles, and still worse at 50 and 100.

verdicts.text: Beat random by 0.70% on 4h, carried by uptrends. It fires in volatile candles, so price moved more after them in a window that rose, which is not the same as picking direction.
Beat random by 0.07% on 1h, a small gap from candles that cluster in volatile stretches of a rising window. Same as random on 4h.
Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, on BTC, ETH and SOL alike.
Beat random on 4h at 20 candles only, and on daily only because of 3 entries between Dec 28, 2022 and Jan 14, 2023. Same as random on 1h.

verdicts.use: Volume fading, long side (cross down through 0)
verdicts.text: Worse than random for longs on 4h at 20, 50 and 100 candles. On daily it was worse in downtrends.

notes: On 4h, VO(5,10) above 20 gave 2,294 entries in 719 separate moves. Twenty candles later, price was 0.70% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that tops out at 0.43%. The gap holds without its strongest stretch on Jan 2–4, 2021, and at 10, 20 and 50 candles, but not at 100. Uptrends carry it, at 0.93% ahead. In downtrends it was the same as random.

VO above 20 fires when short-term volume runs well ahead of longer-term volume, which means volatile candles. The luck band keeps the timing of the signals but not that volatility, so in a window where price rose, bigger moves after these candles show up as a gain for longs. Read it as price moving more after them, not as VO picking direction. On 1h the same setting beat random only at 20 candles. On SOL alone it was 0.41% ahead.

VO above 0 on 1h is the most common reading, with 64,546 entries in 395 moves. It was 0.07% ahead of random against a band of 0.04%. That holds without the stretch between Feb 12, 2021 and Mar 28, 2021, and at 50 and 100 candles, but not at 10. BTC alone was the same as random, and ETH and SOL each rest on one stretch. In both uptrends and downtrends the result is fragile.

Crosses carry less. On 1h, VO crosses up through 0 more than twice as often as it crosses up through 20, and neither did better than random there. On 4h the cross up through 20 beat random at 20 candles only. On daily it rests on 3 entries between Dec 28, 2022 and Jan 14, 2023.

The cross down through 0 is where VO showed something steady, and it points against longs. On 4h, longs opened on it were 0.24% behind random after 20 candles, below a band that starts at -0.19%. It held without its strongest stretch and was worse at 50 and 100 candles. On daily, in downtrends, it was 2.74% behind at every horizon from 10 to 100 candles. In uptrends it was the same as random.

For a long DCA bot, VO above 20 on 4h fits as a filter that times entries into active candles beside a trend condition. Test whether its larger moves suit your take profit distance and DCA step. It stops helping when the pair trades below its 200-day average. A falling VO on 4h or daily in a downtrend is a reason to keep long entries out, not a signal on its own.
